title: The Gaussian Wave for Graphs of Finite Cone Type
summary: We show that for any infinite tree of finite cone type satisfying a mild expansion condition, the only typical process on its vertices with covariance induced by the Green's function is the Gaussian wave. This generalizes a result of Backhausz and Szegedy, who proved this for the infinite regular tree of degree $d\geq 3$. We do this by giving a reduction to a statement concerning the distribution of the inner product of our process with columns of the Green's function, which in turn are straightforward to calculate.
